QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] The Oncoming Shadow
QuestInfo.0: Gather information on Independent Task Force Iruvata from #p9401517# in the Akihabara Command Center.
QuestInfo.1: Iruvata, one of the Blaze Army's deadliest units, can carry out operations without support from #o9601831#. However, according to #p9401517#, the #o9601830# among them serves as their commanding officer. If you can destroy that officer and recover its transmitter, you may be able to neutralize the whole unit. For Zipangu!
QuestInfo.2: You've devastated the #o9601830# force, but now there's another threat: a man, possessed of unknown power, who's bypassed every one of the command center's defenses. No one here can stop him -- but you can.
